title: Directory
intro: The directory is shared by every meeting of {workspace}.

statusHints.directory: In the directory only: they don't sign in

inviteHint: They receive an email with a link valid for 14 days.
addHint: For people who don't sign in: they still get a profile, a check-in and a birthday.
emailLocked: Tied to their account: they change it themselves.
birthdayHint: Day and month only, never the year.
linkNoMail: No mail server is configured: copy the link and send it yourself.
linkShare: You can also share this link with them directly.
removeConfirm: Remove {name} from {workspace}? Their profile and access are deleted; what they said in meetings stays, signed by a former member.
phoneHint: For SMS and WhatsApp reminders, in international form (+33…). Optional.
